features_build.etf_source: ml/label_study.py name rule (P1 etf_list.csv absent at build time)

definitions.mkt_ret_20: compounded 20-session return of the equal-weight universe index; the EW daily return at t is the mean 1-day return at t over names in the universe at t-1 (ETFs excluded; single-day |r| > 0.22 excluded as corporate-action artefacts)
definitions.mkt_dd_252: EW index level / its trailing 252-session max (incl. t; min 126 obs) - 1
definitions.mkt_vol_20: sample sd of the EW daily return over 20 sessions
definitions.mkt_breadth_200: share of universe names (ex-ETF) at t with close above their 200-session SMA (SMA needs >= 120 obs; names without it excluded)
definitions.sessions_since_selloff: EOD sessions since the last date with mkt_ret_20 < -0.08 (0 on such a date); 252 if none within reach (capped at 252)
definitions.cs_dispersion_20: cross-sectional sd of mom_20 over universe names (ex-ETF) with flag_split_20d == 0
definitions.vix_close: India VIX close (ind_close_all) on date t
definitions.ind_mom_20: median mom_20 over universe names in the stock's industry group at t; NaN if < 5 non-NaN names
definitions.ind_ret_63: median ret_63d over the industry group at t; NaN if < 5
definitions.indn_rank_mom_20: percentile rank (pct=True, average ties) of mom_20 within the industry group at t; NaN if < 5
definitions.secidx_ret_20: 20-session return (index's own file calendar) of the sector index mapped to the stock's industry (sector_index_map.csv; Healthcare falls back to Nifty Pharma where the Healthcare index return is missing); names in unmapped industries, Unclassified names and ETFs take the Nifty 500 20-session return (leak-safe deviation from the brief's NaN: a NaN here would mark membership of today's index lists)
definitions.fo_member: 1 if the stock has a stock future in that day's F&O bhavcopy, 0 if the file exists and it has none, NaN if the day's file is missing
definitions.fut_basis_near: (near-month futures settle / spot close - 1) x 365 / calendar days to expiry; NaN if days to expiry < 2
definitions.fut_oi_chg_5: log(fut_oi_total_t / fut_oi_total 5 F&O sessions earlier); NaN unless a member at both dates
definitions.fut_oi_z_60: (fut_oi_total - rolling 60-session mean) / rolling 60-session sd, F&O calendar, >= 40 member sessions in the window
definitions.pcr_oi: stock-option put OI / call OI (all expiries)
definitions.opt_oi_to_turnover: (call OI + put OI, shares) x spot close / 20-session median EOD turnover (rupees; min 10 obs): option open interest in days of cash-market traded value
definitions.fii_idx_fut_net: (FII Future Index Long - Short) / (Long + Short), participant-wise OI (contracts)
definitions.client_idx_pcr: Client Option Index Put Long / Client Option Index Call Long

fo_unit_continuity.reading: OI is in shares in both formats (identity holds across the switch); UDiFF TtlTradgVol is in contracts (turnover = contracts x lot x price)
